description: Raw writes to research.json / tree.gedcomx.json must go through the MCP writer tools, which validate before persisting. The matcher must stay at least as wide as guard_project_files.py's FILE_WRITE_TOOLS + DEVICE_WRITE_TOOLS -- it decides whether the script runs at all, so a tool the script would deny but the matcher omits is a hole the script can never close. `.*device_commit_files` (not the bare name) because Cowork namespaces it `mcp__remote-devices__device_commit_files` and the plugin cannot control the prefix; the leading `.*` makes it bind even if the matcher is applied as an anchored full match. Over-matching is safe -- the script is the precise filter. It also covers `.*research_append`, because the script routes ownership-restricted sections (see OWNED_SECTIONS) by caller identity; the matcher is part of that guardrail, not packaging detail. It also covers `Agent|Task` (guard_project_files.py's DELEGATION_TOOLS), denied only for `subagent_type: "fork"`, which Cowork's Claude Code offers by default and every path we test turns off. The last alternative names every key of AGENT_ONLY_TOOLS, the tools the script denies the main thread because only agents hold them. They are named rather than matched by `.*`, because every matched call starts a python3 process. A UserPromptSubmit hook, no_project_route.py, adds one conditional sentence to each researcher message: with no project, a request to research a person goes to the research skill. It is silent on the hosted planes, which set GENEALOGY_HOSTED_PLANE, so its text reaches Cowork only.
